data.content:
For the homepage terminal/agent widget, the right model is split behavior:

The surrounding page and widget chrome should follow the locale direction, so in Arabic the page is RTL and the terminal card tilt/window controls can mirror with the rest of the homepage. But the actual terminal command line should stay LTR, because shell syntax, package names, URLs, quotes, cursor position, and copy affordances are code-like. Real RTL terminal content usually treats command input as an LTR paragraph, while letting RTL text inside the command render via the bidi algorithm.

I found the widget already mirrored its 3D tilt with `:dir(rtl)` in [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue#L412), but the command row inherited RTL from the page. I fixed that in [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CommandCycleRow.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CommandCycleRow.vue#L180) by adding:

```css
direction: ltr;
unicode-bidi: isolate;
text-align: start;
```

That keeps both the terminal command and agent CLI prompt isolated as LTR inside the RTL homepage.
